description: Enrich an IP address with its location, company, and (optionally) associated person data via a 1:1 match against PDL's IP dataset. API: GET /ip/enrich.

ip.description: The IP address to enrich, e.g. '72.212.42.169'.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence level required to return a match.

return_person.description: Include associated person data if available.

name: pdl_ip_enrich
title: Enrich an IP address
